summary: MASL — Powered by Ticker: full backend + frontend regression. 32/32 backend pytest passing including new coverage for /api/segments/{page} (recap=5, tonight=5, home=6, reels=4, scores=5, stats=5; 404 on unknown page; zero hockey leaks in every beat), all 5 games carry the expected MASLtv video_id + label, /api/games/{id} returns full home/away objects, /api/home featured_game==mil-uti-17-2 with 5 recaps, and /api/talk returns dual-host arena-soccer replies with ZERO banned hockey terms across 3 different prompts and multi-turn history. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844) verified: cold-open-hero on HOME opens the persistent onair-bar; bar PERSISTS while switching to STATS and SCORES (page content visible behind — no full-screen takeover); onair-close dismisses. RECAP -> recap-game-mil-uti-17-2 opens highlights-player with 'FROM THE BOOTH' commentary, Utica City 2 / Wave 17 score header, and the web-watch (WATCH ON YOUTUBE) fallback correctly rendered on web (WebView is web-unsupported, per instructions). /game/mil-uti-17-2 shows the watch-highlights button and navigates to the highlights player. No hockey terminology leaks in any rendered DOM. Only issues observed are the same non-blocking React Native Web deprecation warnings from iteration 1.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. Non-blocking. Reference: multiple StyleSheet blocks (e.g. /app/frontend/app/index.tsx mic shadow*).
React Native Web warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents. Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:64.

action_items: Optional cleanup: migrate deprecated 'shadow*' StyleSheet props to 'boxShadow' and move 'pointerEvents' onto style in /app/frontend/app/index.tsx (line 64). These are React Native Web warnings only — do not affect functionality or native builds.
No functional fixes required. Feature set (persistent on-air panel with per-page banter, real MASLtv highlights player, game-detail WATCH HIGHLIGHTS) is working end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: /api/segments/{page} correctly returns 404 for unknown page; beat shape {id,host,kicker,text} matches contract on all six pages.
GAMES dataset in masl_data.py — all 5 games carry non-empty video_id + label; featured=True only on mil-uti-17-2 which matches /api/home featured_game.

highlights/[id].tsx correctly gates react-native-webview behind Platform.OS !== 'web' and renders a testable web-watch fallback with a hqdefault thumbnail — this preserves the demo experience on the web preview.

BroadcastProvider persists ON-AIR overlay at the app root (BroadcastProvider wraps TabsHost in app/index.tsx), so switching tabs via TopTabBar keeps the bar mounted while onPage() swaps the per-page beats. No full-screen takeover observed.

Segments knowledge layer + system prompt combination successfully suppresses hockey terminology across curated content AND live LLM output — verified against Claude Sonnet 4.6 (3 prompts, 2 multi-turn).
seed_data_creation: None. Content is served from /app/backend/masl_data.py. Talk sessions persist in Mongo talk_sessions during LLM tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: conftest.py reads EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. Backend tests hit real Claude Sonnet 4.6 (~5-15s per /api/talk call). WebView video does NOT play on the web preview — do NOT fail highlights tests on this; the app renders a data-testid='web-watch' fallback in that case. testIDs to know: cold-open-hero, onair-bar, onair-mute, onair-close, recap-game-<id>, highlights-player, web-watch, watch-highlights.
